note: Replies written to look like a small on-device model's, mistakes included (a date in its own words, a trimmed quote, a child or a thing to bring the message doesn't name, a sentence that isn't there, a fancy title). They test that the engine keeps what the message supports and drops the rest. They are not a measure of Apple's model: that is measured on an iPhone in week 2.
